item.title: King tides could break decades-old records and flood communities on both coasts on Thanksgiving week
item.description: Two storms, including a major Nor'easter on the east coast, are expected to impact millions of people celebrating the holiday with family and friends. [Confirmado] Fuentes: Associated Press, BBC News, The New York Times

item.title: Dow craters 1,000 points, Nasdaq loses 4% as Nvidia leads resumption of AI sell-off: Live updates
item.description: USGS recorded a magnitude 4.2 earthquake, 10 km WSW of Point MacKenzie, Alaska. [Confirmado] Fuentes: USGS (earthquakes), CNBC

item.title: Will wind ground your favorite balloon in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Parade?
item.description: Strong winds and heavy rain are expected to impact celebrations across the USA, with the risk that the famous Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade could be impacted. [Confirmado] Fuentes: Associated Press, Reuters, BBC News

item.title: World News in Brief: Vaccine crisis in Yemen, aid for Ukraine, another UNRWA staffer killed
item.description: More than 364,000 people have been displaced in Yemen since the beginning of August as fighting and insecurity continue, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) said on Tuesday. [Probable] Fuentes: UN News

item.title: Trump gives the Medal of Freedom to Giuliani, a fierce political ally who led New York through 9/11
item.description: The award honored a Trump ally who was once known as “America’s mayor” but whose reputation was tarnished by his efforts to overturn the 2020 election on behalf of the president. [Confirmado] Fuentes: Associated Press, Reuters, The New York Times

item.title: Whatever Works Recalls Microwave Grills Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard
item.description: Consumers should stop using the recalled grills immediately and contact Whatever Works for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “Recalled” on the grill and send a photo of the marked grill to… [Probable] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission
